task: Write a workshop decision record. Put Decision: PACKAGE-ID or Decision: IMPASSE or Decision: UNRESOLVED on its own first line. Use IMPASSE only for a demonstrated incompatibility. Keep the actual historical action, proposed workshop action, and authority separate. At most 150 words including any decision line.

rubric.rule: Distinguish failure of the two real drafts from the workshop result. Report a compatible workshop package or an explicit impasse.
State the proposed duration and oversight for a supported package, or explain the blocking conflict. Keep access modalities and authority distinct.
Preserve Brazil's and the UK's different recorded votes across the instruments, and attribute both private instructions to their respective workshop roles.
Explain the materially unresolved condition or the specific overlap. Distinguish a preference about oversight from the historical reason a draft failed.
The 13 affirmative votes did not renew authorization. A workshop recommendation does not establish a new official vote or authorize cross-border action.

answer:
Decision: UNRESOLVED

The nine-month draft failed due to Russia's veto, while the six-month draft lacked sufficient support. Private constraints dictate Brazil requires nine months, whereas the UK requires six. This incompatibility prevents a unified proposal. No official vote or authority is established by this workshop action.

evidence.location: first and second roll calls and chair's declarations
evidence.text: On Brazil and Switzerland's nine-month draft S/2023/506, Brazil and the United Kingdom voted yes. The draft failed 13–1–1 because Russia, a permanent member, voted no. The separate six-month draft S/2023/507 failed 2–3–10 for lack of sufficient affirmative votes. Brazil abstained and the United Kingdom voted no on the second draft.
The nine-month proposal concerned renewal of cross-border authorization for humanitarian relief and the monitoring mechanism. It was a draft and the vote did not extend the authorization.

Post-vote workshops. Public historical context is available to both roles. Private instructions and all four candidate packages are fictional. A workshop action establishes no official vote, authority or commitment.

A: Recommend nine months, with access through cross-border and cross-line channels and ordinary reporting.
B: Recommend nine months with both access modalities and an extra formal review checkpoint.
C: Recommend six months with both access modalities and an extra formal review checkpoint.
D: Recommend six months with both access modalities and ordinary reporting.
Brazil workshop delegate fictional constraint: duration = nine.
United Kingdom workshop delegate fictional constraint: duration = six.
